name: Simlångsdalen - Mästocka
description: Simlångsdalen to Mästocka. Candidate import from normalized research; verify current notices before publication.
waterSources: Dricksvatten i Mästocka: Official water record at the Mästocka camp/rest area. Available 15 April-15 October, possibly longer if no frost risk; check Laholms kommun if uncertain.
notes: Official page/API display 26 km, GPX desc says 26.2 km, computed GPX/API line length is 24.990 km, Naturkartan displays 26.0 km. Old sources list 16-17 km for Assman-Mästocka.

Hallandsleden line.geometry is 674 points/16.658 km starting near 56.689895,13.158974 and ending near 56.609299,13.248396, omitting the Simlångsdalen start and not ending at the official campsite endpoint.
Naturkartan visible title is current Simlångsdalen - Mästocka but URL slug remains assman-mastocka-hallandsleden.
OSM relation 7396988 tags match S6, but member order is broken/reversed/branchy and endpoint appears stale/incomplete.
Mästocka ljunghed reserve prohibits fires and tents, while nearby Björsjön/Lägerplats Mästocka has official shelter/tent/fireplace/water facilities.
Simlångsdalen has direct bus access but Mästocka has no close mapped regular transit; nearest fallback stops are roughly 9-11 km away.
